# rixl_payment_method (Resource)

Attaches and manages a payment method for an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_payment_method" "card" {
  org_id            = var.rixl_org_id
  payment_method_id = "pm_01h7abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `payment_method_id` (String)

### Optional

- `org_id` (String)
- `set_as_default` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `brand` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `details` (String)
- `exp_month` (String)
- `exp_year` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `last4` (String)
- `provider_name` (String) Payment provider (e.g. stripe). Named provider_name because "provider" is reserved by Terraform for provider selection.
- `type` (String)
